headline: Kazakhstan Targets Increased Local Procurement in $8 Billion Energy Sector
summary: Prime Minister Olzhas Bektenov instructed Kazakh agencies to raise domestic manufacturing content in the country's $8 billion energy procurement market above 55.4%.
why: Kazakhstan's energy sector represents the primary destination for foreign direct investment in Central Asia.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Government ordered higher local content shares in energy procurement contracts.
